text:
adele: Quick heads-up — during q8x4 onboarding the model shows recall drop for low-frequency intents (support-ticket:billing, legacy-config). eval harness shows tail accuracy -2.3% and hallucination +4.5% on our promptset :frowning:
vikram: ack. is this isolated to longctx or also short prompts?
adele: mostly long prompts (>512 tokens) and prompts with noisy entities. short prompts look fine.
toni: could be quantization kernel mismatch for attention when sequences span multiple windows. any failing examples we can add to golden?
adele: adding 100 flagged examples to /eval/curation/bugs/q8x4-longtail.csv — will include paraphrases and masked PII variants. want label ops to relabel a subset.
labelops-bot: @labelops scheduled a 2h relabel job tonight: job_id=relab-q8x4-2026-03-21, buckets=10. ETA by 08:00 PT.
sam: propose dedupe strategy: cluster by tf-idf + embed-sim, then within each cluster run greedy ngram dedupe. will avoid dropping paraphrase variants we need.
vikram: also add a canary set of 20 hallucination prompts to detect regressions in CI. add them under /eval/canary/q8x4-halluc.json
adele: list of canary prompts and golden labels uploaded. CI hook needs to fail on hallucination increase >2pp.
ci-bot: CI: added q8x4-halluc canary check to pipeline. threshold: delta_halluc > 2.0 -> fail
toni: after relabel, let's run small quant ablation: int8 static vs q8x4 dynamic kernel. log both perplexity and recall on holdout.
vikram: scheduling ablation on devgpu pool tonight. will post results in this thread.
adele: thanks — will monitor and follow up with updated golden snapshot and labeling notes. :thumbsup:
